topic.title: Ground Conditions / Contaminated Land / Land Stability
topic.source_contract: site history, preliminary conceptual model, contamination and geotechnical risks, coal and mining hazards, intrusive investigation, risk assessment, remediation strategy, verification, planning conditions, regulator acceptance, construction, monitoring and suitability evidence

scope_guards: A historic potentially contaminative use is not proof of unacceptable risk.
A database screening result is not a site investigation.
A preliminary conceptual model is not a completed risk assessment.
A remediation strategy is not evidence of completed remediation.
Planning condition discharge is not inferred from submitted documents.
Completed earthworks are not treated as verified remediation.
Generic criteria are not substituted for site-specific suitability evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact investigation, risk assessment, remediation, verification and monitoring evidence.
